worldcombat.skill.aerialace.summary: The user blinks past in a burst of speed; the pass itself is the blade line, cutting everyone it crosses, and unless something blocks it the user ends up behind the target. There is no accuracy roll, but only what the lane truly crosses is cut — a foe that strafes out of the lane, or a wall in the way, leaves the pass empty.
The pass crosses %1$s cuts of about %2$s Flying contact damage each; every enemy the lane crosses takes all of them, and each enemy is caught only once per cast. Only what the lane truly crosses is cut: a foe that strafes out of it, or a wall in between, leaves the pass empty. The target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on the hit.

One pass covers up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, with a %3$s block lane width; unless it is blocked, it sweeps past the target and ends up behind it. The lane direction is locked at commit and no longer turns after the target.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.growth.0: At level %1$s: cut power %2$s and %3$s cuts.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.growth.1: At level %1$s: cut power %2$s and reach %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.0: A crossing cut delivered in one pass
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.1: Sweep everyone along one straight line
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.2: Pass the target and end up behind it
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.preference.s: On: skimming low widens the lane and extends the reach so one pass sweeps a row, but each cut is about 18%% weaker and windup/cooldown are longer. Off: a high, tight and heavier single cut, faster.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of dashing. Larger values let it cut in from further.
On: a moving enemy is preferred, because the lane cuts across its path; off: order it like a plain melee slash.
On: the user may leave its post to dash at a target; off: it only strikes from where it stands.
